title: Denial at the meeting at Swedish military headquarters
summary: Dennis Asberg tells of Denial at the meeting at Swedish military headquarters, about after 2011 at Military headquarters, Stockholm, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And he just look at me. "No, no, no, no, no. We have not been there." "But you have been filming you. I have filmed you. So, I know you have been there."

plain: Dennis Asberg, a Swedish treasure hunter who says he found a UFO-like object on the seafloor in 2011, tells of a later meeting at military headquarters in Stockholm. He says an officer flatly denied the military had ever been to the site, and Asberg answered that he had filmed them there himself, so he knew they had been. He tells it as proof the military was hiding its interest in the find.
